description: Compliance pre-screen for Ramp accounting agent payments — run before issuing an Agent Card to eliminate unnecessary human approval queues. Performs 5 checks in parallel: (1) FATF country risk on source and destination country, (2) amount threshold flags (CTR-equivalent at $10K, large-payment at $100K), (3) OpenSanctions global sanctions screen by counterparty name, (4) OpenSanctions PEP screen for individual counterparties or payroll, (5) GLEIF UBO chain with sanctions at each beneficial ownership node (if LEI provided). Returns APPROVED / FLAGGED / BLOCKED with a humanRequired boolean — true only for FLAGGED cases. APPROVED: issue card automatically, no human needed. BLOCKED: halt, do not proceed, do not notify counterparty. FLAGGED: route to compliance queue. Removes human-in-the-loop for the ~95% of payments that are clean.

amount.description: Payment amount in units of currency.

counterpartyLei.description: Optional GLEIF LEI — enables UBO chain check and satisfies FATF R.16 originator identification.

counterpartyName.description: Legal name of the payment counterparty.

isIndividual.description: true if counterparty is an individual (triggers PEP screen). Defaults to false.

paymentType.description: Payment type — payroll automatically triggers PEP screen.

sourceCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 source country. Defaults to "US".

name: ramp.compliance_screen

checks.description: fatfCountry, amountFlags, sanctions, pep, uboChain check details.

fatfR16.description: FATF R.16 satisfied status and basis.

humanRequired.description: true only for FLAGGED — APPROVED payments proceed automatically.
